source: Internet Archive (web.archive.org) snapshots of public CVS Pharmacy help, FAQ and caregiver pages; no store, account or sign-in pages
label: archived copy of the public page, cvs.com refuses requests from outside the United States; reviewer agreement pending
snapshot_choice: For each page, the most recent snapshot before 2026-11-18 that the archive index lists with HTTP 200 and an HTML page; the tool checks this against the index before capturing and stops if a later one has appeared.
note: cvs.com refused every page of the set on 2026-11-27, in two checks at 21:02 and 21:34 UTC (HTTP 403, "CVS.com® is not available to customers or patients who are located outside of the United States or U.S. territories."). Each screenshot is therefore taken from the Internet Archive's copy of the same public page. This tool does not contact cvs.com: it blocks every request outside archive.org, and the capture stops if a page tries one (none did). The archive's toolbar and the archived pages' floating cookie notices are hidden before capture. On help pages whose fade-in script does not run in the archive, the main content is set back to full opacity, as each entry states. Phone numbers and email addresses in a captured region are covered by grey boxes and listed per entry; the captured regions show no names, addresses, prescription, member or card numbers, dates of birth or free text. Width and height are read from the saved PNG. The App copies no branding, text or images from these pages.
